intro: A growing, curated list of reports, readings, books, tools and links I return to often. Always check the latest edition before citing.

items.title: World Energy Trilemma Index
items.author: World Energy Council
items.note: Country rankings across energy security, equity and environmental sustainability.

items.title: World Energy Outlook
items.author: International Energy Agency
items.note: Widely cited global scenarios for energy supply, demand and emissions.

items.title: Tracking SDG 7: The Energy Progress Report
items.author: IEA, IRENA, UN DESA, World Bank and WHO
items.note: The official progress report on each SDG 7 target.

items.title: Canada's Energy Future
items.author: Canada Energy Regulator
items.note: Long-term energy supply and demand projections for Canada.

items.title: Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change (AR6 Working Group III)
items.author: IPCC
items.note: Includes detailed chapters on energy systems and mitigation pathways.

items.title: The concept of energy security: Beyond the four As
items.author: Cherp, A. & Jewell, J.
items.note: Energy Policy. A helpful critique of common energy security definitions.

items.title: Energy justice: A conceptual review
items.author: Jenkins, K., McCauley, D., Heffron, R., Stephan, H. & Rehner, R.
items.note: Energy Research & Social Science. Sets out distributional, procedural and recognition justice.

items.title: Community renewable energy: What should it mean?
items.author: Walker, G. & Devine-Wright, P.
items.note: Energy Policy. A short, influential piece on process and outcome in community energy.

items.title: Energy justice: Conceptual insights and practical applications
items.author: Sovacool, B. K. & Dworkin, M. H.
items.note: Applied Energy. Connects justice principles to practical energy decisions.

items.title: Sustainable Energy — Without the Hot Air
items.author: David J. C. MacKay
items.note: A clear, numbers-first introduction to energy supply and demand. Free to read online.

items.title: Energy and Civilization: A History
items.author: Vaclav Smil
items.note: Long-view history of how energy has shaped societies.

items.title: Global Energy Justice: Problems, Principles, and Practices
items.author: Benjamin K. Sovacool & Michael H. Dworkin
items.note: A comprehensive grounding in energy justice principles.

items.title: Our World in Data — Energy
items.author: Our World in Data
items.note: Interactive charts on energy production, consumption and emissions.

items.title: IEA Data and Statistics
items.author: International Energy Agency
items.note: Global energy data, with some free datasets and charts.

items.title: Zotero
items.author: Open-source reference manager
items.note: Free tool I use to collect, organise and cite readings.

items.title: SDG 7 — Department of Economic and Social Affairs
items.author: United Nations
items.note: Official targets, indicators and progress updates for SDG 7.

items.title: School of Environment and Sustainability
items.author: University of Saskatchewan
items.note: Home of the Master of Sustainability programme.

items.title: Energy sources and distribution
items.author: Natural Resources Canada
items.note: Federal information on Canada's energy sources and programmes.
